parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
Image format requirements:

- Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG (8-bit, 16-bit, and 64-bit PNG are not supported), BMP, and WEBP.
- Image size: up to 3 MB.
- Image resolution: less than 2000 × 2000 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.

parameters.name: ReturnForm
parameters.description:
The format of the returned image.

- If set to `mask`, a single-channel black-and-white image is returned.

- If set to `crop`, a cropped 4-channel PNG image is returned (blank edges are cropped).

- If set to `whiteBK`, an image with a white background is returned.

- If not set or set to other values, a 4-channel PNG image is returned.
